concepts.title: Square Numbers and Perfect Squares
concepts.definition: A counting number that comes from multiplying another counting number by itself is a square (a perfect square).
concepts.key_idea: Multiply a counting number by itself and the product is one of these.
question_patterns: check if a given number is a perfect square
find the square of a given integer
calculate the square of a number
determine whether a number is a square number
Is 720 a square number -- why not?

solution_steps.explain: squaring a number n means computing n multiplied by n

concepts.title: Unit Digits of Square Numbers
concepts.definition: The units place digit of any square number depends solely on the units digit of the number being squared, always ending in 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9.
concepts.key_idea: Perfect squares never end with the digits 2, 3, 7, or 8 in their ones place.
question_patterns: what will be the unit digit of the square of a number

solution_steps.action: square the ones digit and take remainder modulo 10
solution_steps.explain: the unit digit of the product is the unit digit of last_digit squared

concepts.title: Number of Zeros in Square Numbers
concepts.definition: When a number ending in zeros is squared, the total count of trailing zeros doubles in the resulting square.
concepts.key_idea: A square number always contains an even number of trailing zeros.
question_patterns: how many zeros will be in the square of a number

calculate trailing zeros of a square number
determine if a number with odd zeros is a perfect square

solution_steps.action: double the count of trailing zeros
solution_steps.explain: squaring a number with zeros doubles the number of zeros at the end

concepts.title: Non-Square Numbers Between Consecutive Squares
concepts.definition: The gap between neighbouring square results n^2 and (n+1)^2 holds exactly 2n non-square values.
concepts.key_idea: There are exactly 2n non-perfect square integers between n^2 and (n+1)^2.
question_patterns: how many natural numbers lie between squares of two consecutive numbers
find the non-square numbers between n^2 and (n+1)^2
calculate numbers lying between two consecutive squares

solution_steps.action: multiply the smaller integer base by 2
solution_steps.explain: the number of non-square integers between n^2 and (n+1)^2 is 2 times n

concepts.title: Sum of First n Odd Numbers
concepts.definition: Add up 1 + 3 + 5 + ... for the opening n odd numbers and you land on n x n.
concepts.key_idea: The opening n odd values, totalled, give n squared.
question_patterns: find the sum of first n odd natural numbers without adding
calculate sum of consecutive odd numbers

solution_steps.action: square the count of odd numbers
solution_steps.explain: the sum of first n odd natural numbers is n raised to power 2

concepts.title: Square of an Odd Number as Sum of Consecutive Integers
concepts.definition: Any odd number's square splits into two neighbouring counting numbers (7 x 7 = 49 = 24 + 25).
question_patterns: express square of an odd number as sum of two consecutive integers

solution_steps.explain: the smaller integer is half of (n^2 - 1)

concepts.title: Finding Square using Binomial Expansion
concepts.definition: Split a number into tens and ones, then expand (a + b)^2 to square it without column multiplication.
concepts.key_idea: Split a number into tens and units to apply algebraic identity (a + b)^2.
question_patterns: find the square of a number without actual multiplication

concepts.title: Pythagorean Triplets
concepts.definition: For any counting number m above 1, the trio 2m, m^2 - 1 and m^2 + 1 satisfies a^2 + b^2 = c^2.
concepts.formula: member1 = 2 * m, member2 = m ** 2 - 1, member3 = m ** 2 + 1
concepts.key_idea: Pick m, compute 2m, m^2 - 1 and m^2 + 1: the first two squares add to the third.
question_patterns: write a Pythagorean triplet whose one member is given

Write a right-triangle trio taking m = 6.

concepts.title: Square Root Concept as Inverse Operation
concepts.definition: Squaring asks which number times itself gives this; that answer (the non-negative one) is the root.
concepts.key_idea: Root-finding undoes squaring, the way subtraction undoes addition.
question_patterns: what is the square root of a given number
find the positive square root
calculate the inverse of squaring
determine the square root of a perfect square

solution_steps.explain: compute the non-negative square root of the number

concepts.title: Square Root by Prime Factorisation
concepts.definition: A technique to compute square roots or make numbers perfect squares by expressing the number as a product of prime factors and forming pairs.
concepts.key_idea: Every prime factor occurs an even number of times in a perfect square.
question_patterns: find square root by prime factorisation method
find the smallest number by which a given number must be multiplied to get a perfect square

solution_steps.action: calculate square root using prime factors
solution_steps.explain: group prime factors in pairs and multiply one factor from each pair

concepts.title: Square Root by Long Division Method
concepts.definition: An algorithm to calculate square roots of large numbers or decimal numbers by grouping digits into pairs under bars and performing stepwise division.
concepts.key_idea: Group digits in pairs from the right; every bar yields one digit of the answer.
question_patterns: find the square root by long division method

solution_steps.action: compute square root using division method
solution_steps.explain: apply long division on digit pairs to find the exact square root
